title.value: Regret measure in continuous time limit for a stochastic Multi-armed bandit problem

abstract.value: We study a class of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems with a risk-sensitive regret measure within a continuous limit setting. This problem is interesting when optimizing the expected reward is not the foremost objective, and the problem horizon is long. Through scaling the state parameters, including the number of pulls and cumulative reward for each arm we study the  bandit problem with infinite horizon, we delineate such risk using a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation with quadratic growth. Using this approach, we establish an explicit form of the optimal policy associated with the considered risk. As an application, we present examples where the results obtained in continuous time offer insights into the optimal policy for each case. Finally, numerical experiments confirm the theoretical results are presented.
